E. It clarifies the relationship between law and society.
F. It explains the nature of power-conferring rules.
G. It distinguishes between legal and ethical obligations.
H. It provides a guideline for the application of laws.
I. It explains the role of judicial discretion in the law.

Provide the correct letter choice in \boxed{X}, where X is the correct letter choice. Keep the explanation or feedback within 3 sentences.
